import {checkDialect} from '../dialect/authoring' import {LoadingState} from '../ui/LoadingState' import {useState} from 'react' import {msg} from '../i18n' import {Button} from '../ui/Button' import {Disclosure} from '../ui/Disclosure' import {Notice} from '../ui/Notice' import {humanId} from '../packs/logicModel' import {dialectAPI,type DialectPackBinding,type PreparationReply,type PreparedRow} from './client' import styles from './DialectsView.module.css' export function ConversionPreview({saved,value,disabled,onChecked,expanded=false}:{saved:PreparationReply;value:DialectPackBinding;disabled:boolean;onChecked?:(identity:string)=>void;expanded?:boolean}){ const [result,setResult]=useState<{identity:string;rows:PreparedRow[]}>(),[busy,setBusy]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState('') const identity=JSON.stringify([saved.sha256,value]),rows=result?.identity===identity?result.rows:undefined async function check(){setBusy(true);setError('');try{await checkDialect(value.mapping,value.pack);const result=await dialectAPI<{rows:PreparedRow[]}>('/'+saved.document.id+'/conversion-preview','POST',{qualification:value},saved.sha256);setResult({identity,rows:result.rows});onChecked?.(identity)}catch(e){setError((e as Error).message)}finally{setBusy(false)}} return

{msg('Preview these conversions across your current records before saving. Originals remain unchanged.')}

{error&&{error}}{rows&&<>

{msg('{{count}} records · {{issues}} with issues',{count:rows.length,issues:rows.filter(r=>r.issues.length).length})}

{rows.filter((r,index)=>index===0||r.issues.length>0).flatMap(row=>[...Object.entries(row.prepared).filter(([target])=>!row.issues.some(i=>i.target===target)).map(([target,value])=>),...row.issues.map(issue=>)])}
{msg('Record')}{msg('Dialect')}{msg('Used for evaluation')}
{saved.document.records.find(r=>r.id===row.id)?.name}{humanId(target,target)}{JSON.stringify(value)}

}
